answer: Before earning, each identity completes 4 unpredictable sequential rounds, each lasting at least 8 minutes, and locks 195 POA through a 10-epoch dispute window. The vine beacon seeds each round, oasis names its signed trace, and grove anchors the final receipt. Parallel fake accounts need separate hardware time and separate bonds, so N aliases cost N×4 rounds plus N×195 POA; validators replay every trace.
